long_biography.plain_text:
When BTS Company opened a dedicated technology centre in Ljubljana in 1996, it displayed thousands of industrial tools and represented international makers. Sandi Boh and his brother Tomaž had founded the company six years earlier, extending their family's toolmaking tradition into a distributor serving metalworking businesses. The new centre made technical products, advice and service available under one roof.

The brothers' business later moved beyond cutting, measuring and grinding tools to supply machinery, robotics and more complete production solutions. Its team also helps install and start up computer-controlled equipment for industrial customers. Sandi remains a director and co-owner alongside Tomaž, with BTS active in Slovenia and neighbouring markets. He has spoken about testing a new tool with customers on their own production lines before introducing it more broadly. That practical work, rather than manufacturing the equipment itself, remains at the heart of the enterprise.
